full_description:
The Purair® CAGEX creates a safe work environment for animal research laboratories through innovative filtration technology. This specialized ductless fume hood is designed to protect both users and the environment from animal dander and bedding material particulates generated during laboratory operations.

The system incorporates high-efficiency carbon filters to effectively absorb odors while optional HEPA filtration contains harmful particulates generated during cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal procedures. The ergonomic design includes a mounted waste container for rapid waste disposal within the protected work zone.

Built with a durable, chemically resistant cabinet frame and easy-to-clean work surfaces, the Purair CAGEX features a hinged front sash for convenient access. The high-efficiency EC blower and energy-saving LED lighting ensure optimal performance while minimizing energy consumption.

Safety features include a filter blockage alarm and improved filter clamping that eliminates bypass leakage, while the optional mobile cart offers ergonomic use and maximum flexibility in laboratory settings. All construction complies with current technical and safety regulations for animal research facilities.
seo_content:
Advanced Animal Research Laboratory Protection

The Purair CAGEX ductless fume hood represents the latest advancement in laboratory safety equipment for animal research facilities. By combining carbon filtration for odor control with optional HEPA filtration for particulate containment, this system creates a comprehensive protection solution for laboratory personnel working with animal cages and bedding materials.

Applications in Animal Research

  • Cage cleaning operations
  • Bedding material changes
  • Laboratory waste disposal
  • Animal dander containment
  • Odor control in research environments

Filtration Technology

The Purair CAGEX utilizes multiple filter formulations to address specific laboratory needs:

  • GP Plus! filters for solvent, organic and alcohol removal
  • ACI Plus!/SUL filters for neutralizing volatile inorganic acid vapors
  • ACR filters for iodine and methyl iodide vapors
  • ACM filters for mercury vapor
  • AMM filters for ammonia solutions and low molecular weight amines
  • FOR filters for formaldehyde and glutaraldehyde fumes
  • HEPA/ULPA filters for powders and particulates
